Geometric topology route map

The GeometricTopology roadmap as a dependency graph, with our mapped contributions highlighted: gray dashed edges form the dependency spine, each route draws its lane in its own color toward its summit, and nodes show individual milestones, so a landed building block and an unfinished route stay visible together.

Goals (long-horizon routes)

Four goals, each a branching tree: shared infrastructure forms the trunk, distinct theorem targets form the branches. Six major proof horizons remain, alongside statement targets and the open Zeeman conjecture. Click a tree node to locate its milestones in the full dependency map.

The map (all 11 layers, our work overlaid)

Rows follow the dependency direction, with subrows for the four route trees. Node colors describe the specific milestone; a green chart-level construction does not make all of Layer 3 complete. Colored lanes are subgraphs of the roadmap dependency schematic, not Lean import claims. Hover or select a node for its contribution, remaining handoff and pinned source.

PR health timeline (the same cohort and time axis)

window (both charts bound) 3-day rolling median · visible merged PRs · dashed continuation: last available median worked-on PR · merged closed, unmerged other roadmap PR · merged open / in review reviewed by us health bands: ≥ 75 ≥ 60 < 60
health = max(0, 100 − (3A + 4D + 3H + 6L + 8B + 12S + 5U)) A max observed round − 1 D distinct rubrics ever non-green H failed scope, API-design, generality, reuse or proof-quality rubrics L rubrics failing in multiple rounds B block rubric/round pairs U exact-head non-green rubrics S explicitly recorded scope/design resets
Health measures review churn, not mathematical quality or review coverage. Missing complete exact-head evidence is unscored, never 100. Merge and close marks sit at the actual event time; open marks at the snapshot time. Edited comments can hide older rounds, so preserved observations are not a complete review history.
median = 3-day rolling median of merged-PR health over the local calendar day and its two adjacent days · this is the SpinRep churn metric evaluated on this roadmap's preserved evidence · open, closed-unmerged and unscored PRs stay out of it · the dashed line carries the last available median to the snapshot
